query:
UPDATE purchaseOrderItems poi
SET poi.productId = (
  SELECT id FROM products 
  WHERE name LIKE '%Heineken%350%' 
  LIMIT 1
)
WHERE poi.purchaseOrderId = 480006 
AND poi.productId IN (
  SELECT id FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%Heineken%330%'
)
